title: Deactivating and reactivating a term each write a row
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Net 45 is active.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 45" row.
  2. Click "Deactivate".
  3. Click the "Inactive" tab.
  4. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 45" row.
  5. Click "Reactivate".
  6. Click the "⋯" page menu beside "New Credit Term".
  7. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The toast "Net 45 deactivated" shows.

Step 3:

  • Net 45 is listed.

Step 4:

  • The menu opens.

Step 5:

  • The toast "Net 45 reactivated" shows.

Step 6:

  • The menu opens.

Step 7:

  • The two newest rows read, newest first: "Credit term reactivated" / "Net 45: 45 days after the invoice date", then "Credit term deactivated" / "Net 45: 45 days after the invoice date".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • S12-R3 table, deactivated: “A term is deactivated (Story 2: Row menu actions) | "Credit term deactivated" | "{name}: {rule}"”
  • S12-R3 table, reactivated: “A term is reactivated (Story 2: Row menu actions) | "Credit term reactivated" | "{name}: {rule}"”
  • S12-R2: “"Audit Log" opens a window titled "Credit Terms Log" with the same layout as the Work Order Log and the Part Sale Log: a search box, then a table with the columns Event, User, Details, Date and Time, newest first.”
